title: ActionCallRecord
description:
The idempotency record of a committed call (the values of its
[`ACTION_CALL_TYPE`] object).

actionArtifactId.description:
The action artifact that was admitted when the call committed. Missing
only on records written before action attribution was recorded.

actionVersion.description:
The action artifact version that was admitted when the call committed.
Missing only on records written before action attribution was recorded.

effectKind.description:
The effect program that committed this call. Missing in legacy records
written before effect attribution and interpreted as `fire_transition`.

ruleBinding.description: TXN-RULE-1: exact writer closure, action, scope and world identity.

additionalProperties.description: Exact JSON value. Number tokens retain decimal precision and are not binary64 values. Preserve source text or use an exact-decimal JSON parser; JavaScript JSON.parse may lose precision.
Exact JSON value. Number tokens retain decimal precision and are not binary64 values. Preserve source text or use an exact-decimal JSON parser; JavaScript JSON.parse may lose precision.

derivedValues.description: The values produced by each derivation, in declaration order.

preconditionOutcomes.description: Successful precondition results, in declaration order.

turn.description: The turn the call committed in.

rowOperations.description: Normalized row operations committed by a parent-and-rows action.

items.description: Exact JSON value. Number tokens retain decimal precision and are not binary64 values. Preserve source text or use an exact-decimal JSON parser; JavaScript JSON.parse may lose precision.

FactKey.description: Identity of one ontology object in a cell: its type and identity key.

ObjectTypeName.description:
Qualified name of an object type: dotted lower-case namespace segments and
a PascalCase type name (`retail.Sku`, `hr.Employee`), the form v1
`objectKind` already uses. The namespace segments are the type's domain
namespace ([`Self::domain`]).

ActionDerivedValue.description: One field produced by an ordered action input derivation.

value.description:
The exact runtime value written to the effective input. Preserve source
text and use an exact-number JSON parser; JavaScript `JSON.parse` may
lose precision.

ActionPreconditionOutcome.description: The successful outcome of one action precondition.

satisfied.description: Whether it held (successful records contain only `true`).
